The `package()` function installs only built binaries and static documentation/completion files into appropriate system directories, with no unexpected file operations or system modifications.

There are no obfuscated commands, suspicious downloads, network exfiltration attempts, or execution of fetched code from untrusted sources. All operations align with standard AUR packaging practices for Rust applications. The maintainer metadata and upstream URL are consistent with the project's public repository.
